mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which may increase risk of infection and complications in patients on citalopram; additionally, untreated hyperthyroidism can potentiate serotonergic effects and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests and complete blood counts regularly; ensure methimazole effectively controls hyperthyroidism to minimize cardiac and serotonergic risks; counsel patient on signs of infection or agranulocytosis.
